papers.title_en: Hierarchical Diffusion for Camera-controlled Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.authors: Kaihua Chen, Yiming Gong, Deva Ramanan, Tarasha Khurana
papers.evidence: 用于相机控制自回归视频生成的分层扩散框架
papers.tldr: 单图长视频的相机控制生成长期受两个问题困扰：自回归误差随时间累积导致画面漂移，相机控制如何注入也存在歧义，而自强制或显式6-DOF位姿方案成本高且几何不稳。作者提出轻量框架，将自回归生成 WanAR 与分层长上下文去噪 FixAR 结合，并借鉴前馈新视角合成，把视频生成重构为 warping-and-inpainting 问题。方法先以近邻历史生成帧，再用长程子采样历史精修，形成由细到粗的分层去噪，使每帧利用完整时序上下文而避免过高开销。在 RealEstate10k 与 DL3DV 上，WanAR+FixAR 优于先前相机控制长视频方法，兼顾时序稳定与输入相机轨迹一致。
papers.abstract_en: We address the task of long-video, camera-controlled generation from a single image. The dominant autoregressive paradigm suffers from two key limitations: (1) error accumulation over time, as distant frames are conditioned on previously generated outputs rather than ground truth, leading to drift; and (2) ambiguity in how to incorporate camera control. Standard solutions to both--such as self-forcing and conditioning on explicit 6-DOF poses--either incur significant computational overhead or produce drifting scene geometries over time. We propose a simple and lightweight framework that combines autoregressive generation (WanAR) with hierarchical long-context denoising (FixAR). To enforce scene geometry remains consistent with input cameras, we draw from feed-forward novel-view synthesis and reformulate video generation as a warping-and-inpainting problem. To mitigate drift, we introduce a hierarchical denoising strategy in which different stages condition on different temporal histories. Specifically, we first generate frames conditioned on the immediate past, and then refine them using a second denoiser conditioned on a temporally subsampled long-range history to enforce global consistency. This fine-to-coarse scheme enables each generated frame to effectively condition on the full temporal context without incurring a prohibitive cost. Experiments on RealEstate10k and DL3DV demonstrate that WanAR+FixAR outperforms prior methods for camera-controlled long-video generation, producing results that are both temporally stable and consistent with input camera trajectories.

papers.title_en: V-CAPE: Visual Consistency Assessment for Product Image Editing
papers.authors: Iaroslav Melekhov, Roberto Alcover Couso, Francesco Taioli, Daniel Coelho, Artur Bekasov, Virginia Fernandez Arguedas, Jose Miguel Grande Saiz
papers.evidence: 面向生成式图像编辑视觉一致性评估的大规模基准
papers.tldr: 生成式图像编辑可完成背景替换、物体操作与姿态调整，但验证编辑后物体的几何、纹理、颜色和细节等内在视觉属性是否保持一致仍很困难，规模化人工检查不可行。作者提出V-CAPE产品图像编辑视觉一致性评估数据集，含4万对源-目标图像、接受/拒绝标签与结构化失败模式，并融合真实编辑图和3D合成子集。评测中各类规模视觉语言模型在AutoQA上准确率均低于65%，显示任务挑战显著。该工作为细粒度编辑质量评估提供基准。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative image editing enable complex transformations such as background replacement, object manipulation, and pose adjustment from natural language instructions. However, verifying that these transformations preserve visual consistency, defined as the preservation of an object's intrinsic visual attributes, including geometry, texture, color, and fine-grained details, remains a largely unsolved problem. This challenge is particularly pronounced at scale, where manual inspection is infeasible and automated quality assessment (AutoQA) could become essential. In this work, we introduce Visual Consistency Assessment for Product Image Editing (V-CAPE), a large-scale dataset for evaluating visual consistency in generative image editing. The dataset consists of 40K unique source-target product image pairs, each annotated with binary accept/reject labels and structured failure modes capturing fine-grained inconsistencies such as geometric distortions, pose errors, and identity mismatches. V-CAPE combines real-world edited images with a synthetic subset constructed from 3D assets, enabling both realistic evaluation and controlled analysis. Vision-language models (VLMs) across all evaluated size categories on AutoQA achieve accuracy below 65%, indicating that the dataset poses a substantial challenge regardless of model scale. Our results highlight fundamental limitations of current models in verifying visual consistency under transformation, positioning V-CAPE as a benchmark for advancing fine-grained image editing evaluation.

papers.title_en: Freeze What Is Settled, Cache What Is Smooth: Spatial Freezing Keeps Step Caching in Its Low-Error Regime
papers.evidence: 指令式扩散图像编辑器的免训练加速
papers.tldr: 扩散Transformer图像编辑需多步去噪，免训练加速常分步缓存与区域冻结，但高速比预算如何分配尚不明确。作者在Qwen-Image-2.1上建立逐步成本模型，发现冻结降低每步成本，可让缓存采用更保守阈值；进而提出FreezePlan，保留5个完整步，其余交给TaylorSeer，并将冻结token驱动到一步x0估计。预注册测试上端到端5.05倍加速、PSNR 29.8 dB，VLM评分无显著下降；5.99倍时仍达28.0 dB。增益主要来自调度与预算拆分而非区域选择器。
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-based image editors built on diffusion transformers run tens of denoising steps. Training-free acceleration either reuses features across steps (step caching) or stops computing the regions an edit leaves untouched (region freezing), and the two have been combined before. We ask how a high speed-up target should be split between them. On Qwen-Image-2.1, freezing does more than remove tokens: it lowers the cost of every step, so the step cache can reach the same overall speed-up with a conservative threshold that keeps its error small. A per-step cost model fitted on development runs predicts held-out latency with a median error of 4.0% and reproduces the speed ceilings of the region methods we re-implemented (2.73$\times$ predicted vs. 2.70$\times$ measured for RegionE). Driving frozen tokens to the model's one-step $x_0$ estimate beats returning them to the reference image on every development sample, and in 90% of measured cases the composed error stays below the sum of the two individual errors. The resulting method, FreezePlan, keeps five full steps and gives the rest of the budget to TaylorSeer. On a pre-registered test split it runs 5.05$\times$ faster end to end at 29.8 dB PSNR to the original output, with no significant drop in a VLM judge score; TaylorSeer at 5.02$\times$ reaches 23.5 dB. The curve extends to 5.99$\times$ at 28.0 dB. Swapping in the region selectors of prior methods under our schedule lowers median PSNR by only 0.5--0.6 dB, which places the gain in the schedule and budget split rather than in the selector.

papers.title_en: From Structural Feedback to Prompt Policies: Learning Faithful Text-to-Image Prompt Editors
papers.authors: Wentao Ye, Yali Ye, Zhiqing Xiao, Ru Peng, Xinpeng Ti, Liyao Li, Zhanming Shen, Peng Lu, Jie Zhang, Haobo Wang
papers.evidence: 面向文本到图像编辑策略的结构感知提示编辑器
papers.tldr: 文本到图像提示优化应提升图像质量而不改变用户请求场景，但风格化改写会削弱物体属性和关系，即使全局图文相似度仍高。StruPO将校准场景图作为策略条件与图像监督的共享表示，用删除、重排和插入实现词元对齐的局部提示编辑。在三个2K提示测试集和四个冻结生成骨干上，StruPO改善了忠实度—美学权衡，并持续提升关系保真度，人类偏好优势随关系复杂度增加。该工作把结构反馈转为可训练信号，一次生成可复用优化文本，无需迭代批评—重写循环。
papers.abstract_en: Prompt optimization should improve the image a user receives without changing the scene the user requested. Yet stylistic rewriting can weaken object attributes and relations even when global text--image similarity remains high. We propose StruPO, a structure-aware prompt editor that uses a calibrated scene graph as a shared representation for policy conditioning and image-grounded supervision. The graph exposes what should be preserved, while deletion, reordering, and insertion provide a token-aligned way to modify the prompt. This turns structural feedback from an external critique into a training signal for a reusable editing policy. Learning from that signal requires handling both uncertain grounding and stochastic image generation. StruPO retains grounding confidence through smooth reward shaping and averages multiple images for each edit before computing group-relative advantages. Experiments span three disjoint 2K-prompt test sets and four frozen generation backbones, with comparisons to learned prompt optimizers, iterative structural feedback, diffusion-model fine-tuning, and inference-time attention control. StruPO improves the faithfulness--aesthetics trade-off, with consistent gains in relational fidelity. Independent automatic evaluators and a 15-annotator study provide complementary evidence, and human preference margins increase with relation complexity. Controlled ablations connect these gains to graph conditioning, local editing, and image-grounded learning. The resulting policy produces reusable optimized text in one pass after graph calibration, without an iterative critique--rewrite loop.

papers.title_en: PolyGandr: Steering Generative Models via Spatial Navigation through Latent Space
papers.authors: Mingwei S. G. Li, Susie S. Y. Li, Isabel Moreira de Oliveira, Ryan P. Adams, Remco Chang
papers.evidence: 通过潜空间导航操控生成模型的视觉界面
papers.tldr: 生成模型接口主要依赖自然语言，难以进行细粒度控制、迭代精修和开放式探索。PolyGandr 将生成控制建模为潜空间中的高维导航，用户可在统一地图与混合调色板界面中设定起点、转向和步长。它结合全局探索与局部精修，并在 StyleGAN2 人脸、Stable Diffusion 椅子设计和旋转剪纸工程三个用例中验证。结果表明其可补充自然语言引导，支持实时编辑并纵览设计空间。
papers.abstract_en: Generative models support content creation across text, images, videos, and design disciplines, yet their interfaces rely primarily on natural language. While effective for specifying high-level intent, language can be inefficient and imprecise for fine-grained control, iterative refinement, and open-ended exploration. We present PolyGandr, a visual interface for exploring relationships between latent representations and generated outputs, complementing natural-language model steering. PolyGandr formulates generative control as high-dimensional navigation, enabling users to define starting points, steering directions, and step sizes through a unified map-and-mixing-palette interface. Combining global exploration with local refinement supports both broad design-space navigation and fine-grained output manipulation without repeatedly translating visual intent into prompts. We evaluate PolyGandr across three use cases: StyleGAN2 face generation, Stable Diffusion chair design, and rotational kirigami engineering. A formative study indicates that PolyGandr complements existing workflows by supporting real-time editing while simultaneously providing an overview and means to explore the broader design space.

papers.title_en: Unlocking Any-Order Generation in Pretrained Autoregressive Image Models
papers.authors: Rishav Pramanik, Marco Pedersoli, Zhaozheng Yin
papers.evidence: 支持任意顺序的自回归图像生成并可修复与编辑
papers.tldr: 自回归图像生成器用固定栅格顺序训练，把图像分布的单一分解硬编码进模型，推理时无法修复、外扩或编辑。作者提出把预训练栅格扫描模型适配为任意顺序生成器的方案：用未来感知位置嵌入解决目标位置可辨识性问题，再用排序课程引导稳定优化路径。在LlamaGen与RAR四个模型上，ImageNet修复FID 6.21优于MaskGIT的10.44，仅增加13-33%计算，且不改动标准AR推理栈。
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive (AR) image generators are powerful in principle but inflexible in practice: training with a fixed raster-scan order hardcodes a single factorization of the image distribution into the model, leaving it unable to inpaint, outpaint, or edit at inference time. Existing solutions, including the modern discrete-diffusion family, train from scratch on a mixture of token orderings, paying roughly 3x the compute of standard raster-scan training; discrete diffusion further sacrifices compatibility with the AR inference ecosystem (KV caching, vLLM) by construction. We argue that this cost is unnecessary. A pretrained raster-scan AR model has already learned the joint distribution over image tokens; what it lacks is not knowledge but the ability to express that knowledge through non-sequential conditional pathways. We propose a recipe for adapting pretrained raster-scan models into any-order generators using two components: future-aware positional embeddings that resolve a target-position identifiability problem at negligible overhead, and an ordering curriculum that traces a stable optimization path from the pretrained solution to a good any-order basin. Applied to four base models across two architectures and two scales (LlamaGen-L/XL, RAR-L/XL), the recipe substantially outperforms MaskGIT on ImageNet inpainting (FID 6.21 vs. 10.44) and outpainting, is competitive with MAR-L, trades a 1.2-1.9 increase in class-conditional FID for this flexibility, and costs 13-33% additional compute beyond pretraining, while leaving the standard AR inference stack untouched. Inpainting, outpainting, and editing, our results suggest, need not be added to autoregressive image models. They can be unlocked from the ones that exist. Code is available at https://github.com/Ordered-AR/unlockedadaptation.

papers.title_en: MorphSIG: Subject-Driven Image Generation via Decoupled Anchoring and Feature Transport
papers.authors: Hailong Yan, Yongrui Zhang, Xiangtao Zhang, Le Zhang
papers.evidence: 基于特征传输的免训练主体驱动图像生成
papers.tldr: 主体驱动图像生成常受姿态单一与身份漂移困扰。MorphSIG提出免训练框架，将SIG重构为伪视频特征传输，并用渐进解耦锚定与伪流引导传输两个模块协同。前者在早期去噪中频域解耦和结构扰动，打破结构锁定；后者在潜空间构造伪流场迁移主体语义。实验在多样风格主体基准上显著提升姿态多样性与主体保真度，为高保真主体一致性提供低成本新范式。
papers.abstract_en: We propose MorphSIG, a training-free framework that reformulates subject-driven image generation (SIG) as pseudo-video feature transport. MorphSIG contains two core modules: Progressive Decoupled Anchoring, which uses frequency-domain decoupling and structural scrambling during early denoising to break structural locking and enable a gradual transition from free composition to identity alignment; and Pseudo-flow Guided Feature Transport, which constructs a latent-space pseudo-flow field to mimic Image-to-Video temporal coherence and transport subject semantics precisely. To address stylistic homogeneity and the lack of ground truth in existing benchmarks, we further introduce a benchmark with diverse stylized subjects. Extensive experiments show that MorphSIG significantly improves pose diversity and subject fidelity over baselines without additional training. Overall, MorphSIG bridges static generation and dynamic propagation, providing a cost-effective paradigm for high-fidelity subject consistency.

papers.title_en: ROAD: Modern Adversarial Training for Simple One-Step Distillation at Scale
papers.authors: Xiaoou Li, Shan You, Tao Huang
papers.evidence: 文本到图像扩散模型的单步对抗蒸馏
papers.tldr: 单步蒸馏可将预训练扩散模型转为快速生成器，但现代文生图规模下常依赖复杂训练流程与高算力。ROAD提出单阶段纯对抗蒸馏框架，用轻量表示空间判别器、Lipschitz约束Transformer头与周期重采样随机特征混合，并以Jacobian R1稳定稠密向量logits训练。单步生成在SDXL上COCO-10K取得11.03 FID、SD3.5-M上13.73，超过多步教师且训练算力远低于分布匹配。
papers.abstract_en: One-step distillation turns pretrained diffusion models into fast generators, but strong results often require substantial training machinery and compute. Pure adversarial distillation offers a simpler route, yet has struggled at modern text-to-image scale. To address this limitation, we propose ROAD (Representation-grounded One-step Adversarial Distillation), a one-stage framework that distills text-to-image models with one adversarial objective and a lightweight representation-space critic. First, we replace the classical convolutional head with a Lipschitz-controlled Transformer head with token-level text conditioning, which matches the semantic tokens of modern visual encoders. Second, we observed a fixed random feature mixing leads to long-horizon degradation. We attribute it to generator-critic co-adaptation around one realization-specific view, and periodically re-draw the mixing to keep the randomization effective. Third, for our dense and vector-valued logits, we introduce Jacobian R1 which penalizes the full input-logit Jacobian, overcoming pooled R1's limitation of neglecting most of logit sensitivities. A single adversarial objective then suffices: in one step, ROAD reaches 11.03 FID on SDXL and 13.73 on SD3.5-M on COCO-10K, surpassing the multi-step teachers at a fraction of distribution matching's training compute.

papers.title_en: Copying As Defense: Protecting Images from Editing By Eliciting Model Copying
papers.authors: Salma Abdel Magid, Sanghyuk Chun, Eric Slyman, Kushal Kafle, Olga Russakovsky
papers.evidence: 针对基于扩散Transformer的图像编辑模型的防御
papers.tldr: 针对Flux Kontext等扩散Transformer图像编辑器可被滥用于非自愿或有害改图，现有主动防御让输出减少关注受保护参考图，却仍可能按文本生成弱关联新图。本文反其道，提出Copying-as-Defense（CaD），在早期Transformer块最大化目标token对参考图的注意力，诱导模型复制输入而非执行编辑。实验将平均编辑成功率从81.4%降至24.0%，相对降低70.6%，并比最强基线DeContext再降44.3%，单步优化快约1.8-2.0倍。该工作表明“诱发复制”是保护图像免受DiT上下文编辑的有效防御思路。
papers.abstract_en: Image editors built on diffusion transformers (DiTs), such as Flux Kontext, make it possible to turn a single photograph into a convincing manipulated image, including harmful and non-consensual edits. Proactive defenses aim to prevent such manipulations by adding an imperceptible perturbation before an image is shared. Existing defenses for DiT-based in-context editors make the output attend less to the protected reference image. But this leaves the model free to follow the edit instruction using the text and its own generated tokens, often producing a new, weakly grounded image rather than preventing the edit. We find that the opposite strategy is more effective: instead of leading the model to ignore the reference, we encourage it to copy it. Through controlled attention interventions, we show that concentrating target-token attention on the reference image in only a few early blocks is sufficient to collapse the editing behavior, causing the model to reproduce its input, often as a lossy copy, rather than execute the requested transformation. Based on this insight, we introduce Copying-as-Defense (CaD), which maximizes per-token target-to-reference attention mass in early transformer blocks. Since attention rows are normalized, increasing reference attention suppresses the attention allocated to the text and generated canvas. Restricting the objective to early blocks also lets us truncate the backpropagation path, keeping optimization cheap. Across editors and benchmarks, CaD reduces average edit success from 81.4% on unprotected images to 24.0%, a 70.6% relative reduction, and by a further 44.3% relative to DeContext, the strongest baseline (43.0%). CaD is also roughly 1.8-2.0x faster per optimization step than comparable methods.

papers.title_en: Beyond the Estimate: Wiener-Informed Decoding for Easier Training of Pixel-Space Flow Models
papers.evidence: 维纳信息解码改善像素空间流生成模型的训练
papers.tldr: 在像素空间直接学习速度场既困难又缓慢。作者发现冻结的Wiener估计、冻结基与像素解码能带来互补收益，据此提出WiD：用可训练的Wiener预测路径配合系数接口，向原生解码器注入特征并回传系数修正，全部参数在原始像素速度目标下联合训练。在ImageNet 256×256上，PixelDiT-XL加WiD仅500轮即达FID 1.53，训练轮数减少37.5%。这表明统计去噪器的计算结构本身也能加速像素空间训练。
papers.abstract_en: Learning velocity fields directly in pixel space is difficult and slow. We show that coarse second-order image statistics can ease this task: frozen Wiener estimates improve velocity learning, with gains extending beyond the linear predictions they explicitly provide. Moreover, we observe similar but complementary gains from frozen bases and pixel decoding. These observations motivate Wiener-informed Decoding (WiD), which uses statistical knowledge both for direct prediction and to organize decoder computation without modifying native blocks. WiD combines a trainable Wiener prediction path with coefficient interfaces that inject features into the native decoder and return its predicted coefficient corrections, with these components initialized with data statistics. All introduced parameters, including the spectrum and coordinate transforms, are trained jointly under the original pixel-space velocity objective. Across model scales and decoder architectures, WiD accelerates training and improves generation quality with modest parameter overhead. It also yields smoother gradient trajectories and remains effective with representation alignment. WiD improves class-conditional and text-to-image generation across different resolutions. On ImageNet 256 x 256, PixelDiT-XL with WiD reaches FID 1.53 after 500 epochs, achieving comparable quality to PixelDiT with 37.5% fewer training epochs. Statistical denoisers contribute beyond the estimate: their computational structure can also ease pixel-space training.

papers.title_en: Provenance Signatures for Low Rank Adaptations of Image Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Tobias Cheung, Mohan Dantam, Marc Juarez, Rik Sarkar
papers.evidence: 面向LoRA适配图像扩散模型的来源检测
papers.tldr: 扩散模型可通过LoRA高效定制，但开放服务可能借适配生成偏见、有害或非法图像，需追溯其是否基于标准模型。论文在未知适配与未知模型族的开放世界设定下建立来源检测威胁模型，并提出基于生成图像集合内在维度的黑盒模型签名。结合假设检验，该协议可区分基础模型、LoRA适配与其他模型族。工作为扩散模型适配的来源审计提供了无需候选列表的黑盒思路。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have revolutionized the generation of realistic artificial images. Efficient techniques such as Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA) can modify these models for particular use cases, making them more diverse and widely usable. At the same time, open base models may be adapted to deliver biased, harmful or illegal images in an online service. In this paper, we develop a protocol to detect when a service may be using an adaptation of an otherwise standard model. We describe the precise setup and threat model for this provenance question and define two different problems arising due the presence of multiple model families and multiple adaptations. In contrast to previous works that have considered model identification within lists of known candidate models, we consider the realistic open world scenario where the set of possible adaptations and alternative models are unknown. Using a hypothesis testing approach, our protocols can distinguish between the base model, a LoRA adaptation and other completely different families of models. For this test, we develop a black box signature of the models based only on intrinsic dimension of sets of images generated by the models.

papers.title_en: When Diffusion Recommenders Stop Sampling: Preserving Generative Diversity
papers.authors: Louis Castres Saint Martin, Alain Rakotomamonjy, Patrick Gallinari
papers.evidence: 针对扩散推荐模型采样坍缩的潜在扩散框架
papers.tldr: 序列推荐常需面对用户多种可能的下一次交互，但现有目标物品扩散推荐器在独立采样时易出现严重采样崩溃，输出近乎相同。本文提出三阶段潜扩散框架DARTS，将表示学习、生成建模与离散排序解耦：先学习并冻结潜空间，再训练扩散模型，最后在解码阶段引入排序监督。在三个Amazon Reviews 2023类别上，DARTS在保持更高采样多样性的同时，标准排序指标较强基线提升7–12%，多样本后验预测聚合还能进一步提升排序准确率。该工作揭示了扩散推荐采样崩溃的成因，并给出了兼顾多样性与准确性的实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: A user history can admit multiple plausible next interactions, yet conventional sequential recommenders produce a single deterministic ranking. While diffusion models offer a natural way to sample alternative continuations, we show that existing target-item diffusion recommenders often suffer from severe sampling collapse, producing nearly identical outputs across independent draws. We identify two ubiquitous design choices that promote this collapse: joint learning of the latent space and denoiser, and in-trajectory supervision via discrete losses. To address these failure modes, we introduce DARTS (Diverse and Accurate Recommendation Through Sampling), a three-stage latent diffusion framework that explicitly decouples representation learning, generative modeling, and discrete ranking by learning and freezing the latent space before diffusion training and postponing ranking supervision to the final decoding stage. We further characterize sampling diversity using complementary measures of variation before and after decoding, and use posterior-predictive aggregation to exploit this diversity at inference. Across three Amazon Reviews 2023 categories, DARTS preserves substantially greater sampling diversity while outperforming strong sequential, generative-retrieval, and diffusion baselines by 7-12% on standard ranking metrics. Aggregating multiple samples further improves ranking accuracy at a fixed slate size.

papers.title_en: An end-to-end framework for uncertainty-aware validation of generative models
papers.authors: Giada Badaracco, Sean Benevedes, Christina Reissel, Philip Harris, Gaia Grosso
papers.evidence: 生成模型的验证与不确定性量化
papers.tldr: 生成模型密度估计在物理科学中常缺乏可传播不确定性，使验证只能依赖把模型视为精确的点零假设检验。SIGMA将密度估计与原则性不确定性量化端到端结合，采用高斯混合模型并把拟合不确定性作为冗余参数纳入拟合优度检验。在二维玩具模型和QCD背景基准上，纳入不确定性后同一模型可信任的测试集规模提升约一个数量级。该工作为生成模型在物理科学中的稳健验证提供了统计基础。
papers.abstract_en: Density estimation with generative models is a common task in the physical sciences, for example in background estimation in particle physics. Existing machine learning techniques, however, lack methods to quantify uncertainties that can be propagated into a statistical test. That limits the validation of generative models to standard goodness-of-fit tests, in which the generative model is treated as exact (point-null hypothesis). But a model fitted to a finite training set is never exact, so if its uncertainties are neglected, any sufficiently powerful goodness-of-fit test will eventually reject it once the test set is large enough to resolve this estimation error. We propose SIGMA, an end-to-end framework combining density estimation with principled uncertainty quantification. We use Gaussian mixture models, for which uncertainties are tractable, and further construct a new goodness-of-fit test in which these uncertainties are profiled as nuisance parameters to account for the statistical error of the fit, promoting the conventional point-null test to a composite one. A rejection then signals genuine mismodeling rather than a test set large enough to resolve the error of the fit, provided the propagated uncertainties faithfully cover that error. We demonstrate the framework on a controlled two-dimensional toy model and on a collider physics benchmark modeling the QCD background process. With uncertainties included, the same model can be trusted on test sets up to an order of magnitude larger than the standard test allows. Our work thus provides a statistically grounded basis for a robust use of generative models in the physical sciences.
